title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator follow-up mode lets users chat without tagging it
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned follow-up mode from Facilitator's documented behaviour and controls. The roadmap facts, licensing prerequisites and control references are supported, and the page reports the conflicting Microsoft instructions for managing Facilitator.
